manifest.note: The promoted 4-bit/group-64 precision-island proposal head is preserved tensor-for-tensor and extended with a public affine-2 compact draft readout. Candidate code uses that readout only to form a 32-token shortlist, then exactly reranks those rows with the existing affine-4 compact target lm_head before selecting the proposal token. The target forward pass, exact target top-2, emitted-token decision, cache journal, rollback, and trusted serial replay are unchanged. The artifact is immutable-revision and pinned to the runner's single-file model.safetensors tree digest; no remote code is executed.
